<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Supreme Court expansion:</strong> The Rajya Sabha passed a bill to increase the number of Supreme Court judges, though the government&#x27;s use of the Money Bill route and concerns over diversity sparked opposition criticism.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary unrest:</strong> The INDIA bloc, including NC MPs, staged protests demanding the restoration of J-K statehood, contributing to a deepening deadlock that may force an early end to the Monsoon Session.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxNV1BkWUlweFkxMElOeWM1S3hWYUNXTXcyd29uMzZaTXFueWtiemhxckY3eHNPNnplaUI2amlVNllxS1BTRW1aVUlZQUZnYU5KWVNYZmxOMDVMMml5T1BRSjcxbm9zN1lkSVBpUWZyT2Fxb09zNTN1SmhqMkwwR1hCRXktN0loSmNzT3VKRjdwbl9pOTU4dTlmc2dqVTJmQUNHRHZ5V0dUWXlLT2xRSFNycEFZNA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxQeTR4OVhhVlFaUk9BQlJ4MDNCZnRUUFcyb0pqR1FQQ29LcVJwY3NVZ1VzY0FxSWxlOUNBQWNpcXJsdXpUYVVxRmx3SU9odk9XeUpESURVMm5YNlQxT09QQXlkT3VTWXNpN1dJTGlnYkxtTFdVMU42c3ZoU3NIUzNLc3paQlRvQjVKckJOb2h4TjliUlVhLVBWTTFnVQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Agniveer updates:</strong> Minister of State for Home Affairs Nityanand Rai informed the Rajya Sabha that 75% of the first Agniveer batch will exit service, with a 50% quota now established for them in CAPF recruitment.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative setbacks:</strong> The Constitutional Amendment Bill for women’s reservation in the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies failed to pass in the Lok Sabha, even as the Centre continues efforts to revive the legislation.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Bankers&#x27; Books Evidence Bill:</strong> The Lok Sabha approved the Bankers’ Books Evidence Bill without debate amidst ongoing parliamentary disruptions.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTE53bzVzZ0hibHBGQXpKVzdCa3FfZVlfTW9wdGtndm40b2REeUFsTDdOaWU4MFdScHJXTDgyby1MTjJhSTA1WHJrWUVHSkZsaVNBZFBhNjItdGJuWGxqRE5oTFFrV2k1MWtDWWZRLS0yNkxyV3FpaHlUYjNNTQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxNendvS0NtZU81cG80by1CZktrNHVBYzJyMXpwYkg0cDY4V2k4UHFtWGJoY0VLQVhYMlRMVnhQU3NaUXlISTB0YnNPanBZSGxrcWJaejlnVXJGcGg2Rm1ySDZOeldSR3UwYUtQXzQ2c1ExX0RhREwwT2t4RTMyS1k2MjRKc2diUXdfejlpdFVoNVJpRk9HbHhub1NyYkFVNUlPTXZXMzNrYmxTaDQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
